title: Root Cause Analysis Agent Degraded — Latency, Not Accuracy
description: Response time elevated: 1250ms against a 499ms fleet average, with a 2.30% error rate versus 0.62% fleet-wide. Accuracy is still 92.1% and the other three agents are healthy. Operators will feel this as slower root-cause explanations, not wrong ones.
action: Inspect the P95/P99 latency tail, then decide between retraining early and riding it out.

confidence.rationale: These are direct runtime readings, not an inference about health. What the reading does not settle is the cause — the tail moved, and whether that is load or a model problem is the judgment call this console exists to inform.

escalation.reason: Latency above fleet baseline for 3 consecutive windows

title: System Sync Is 45% of Every Anomaly
description: System Sync Issue accounts for 45.0% — 91 of 202 anomaly root causes — ahead of Tax Rule Change at 28.2% and Rate Card Error at 17.8%. The Missing AutoPay pattern operators are clearing right now traces back to that same category.
action: Weight the next retrain toward sync-hardening and tax-rule detection rather than spreading it evenly.

confidence.rationale: Categories are assigned by the RCA agent, which is the agent currently in Warning — so the distribution is trustworthy on volume and slightly less so on the boundary between Rate Card Error and Migration Issue, where the two causes overlap.

title: Retraining Opportunity Ready — 1,847 Corrections Captured
description: 1,847 operator corrections captured this month at Excellent (94%) training-data quality. The next scheduled retrain is March 1, 2026 with an estimated +6–8% confidence. Your last four retrainings averaged +4.9%.
action: Confirm the March 1 schedule, or trigger early retraining while the RCA agent is already degraded.

confidence.rationale: The +6–8% is a projection from four prior retrains, not a measurement — and the prior four ranged +3.8% to +6.4%, so the honest read is 'probably in that band'. That spread is why the console shows the history next to the forecast.

title: Confidence Thresholds Govern Every Auto-Resolution
description: High ≥90% auto-resolves, Medium 70–89% requires operator review, Low <70% requires SME escalation. Current average confidence is 94.2%, up 2.3% on last month. Every anomaly an operator auto-resolves does so because these numbers said it was safe.
action: Tune against the accuracy-versus-review-load trade-off, with the projected shift visible before you commit.

confidence.rationale: Configuration, not a measurement. The uncertainty is entirely in what a change does downstream — which is what the review-load projection beside the sliders is for.

title: SLA and Instance Configuration
description: The BRN SLA window is set to 36 hours; the active instance is Consumer East-02, with 12 operators working across 3 instances. Shortening the window tightens every operator's cycle at once — it is the single setting with the broadest blast radius on this console.
action: Adjust the SLA window or instance assignment as load shifts between cycles.

confidence.rationale: Configuration read directly from the platform. Illustrative, like everything else in this demo.
